ao_file.Description: Alpha Omega file name of the release: <L|R>T<track>D<depth>F<file>

hemisphere.Description: from the file name (LT = left track, RT = right track)

track.Description: microelectrode track number from the file name

depth_mm.Description: recording depth from the file name (Alpha Omega drive depth, mm; negative = below target as defined by the drive)

target.Description: SN = substantia nigra, GP = globus pallidus (release folder)
